bootLitresSeatsUp.note: to the cargo cover: EV Database / Leapmotor EU 435L seats up (Auto Express UK also 435L, frunk 32-34L not added). bootLitresSeatsDown.note: EV Database cargo max 1,410L, same figure Leapmotor AU and Auto Express quote; measurement height not stated, probably to the roof rather than belt line

seats.note: EV Database seats 5; Leapmotor AU page describes a five-seat two-row layout

towKg.note: EV Database braked 1,500kg (EU spec); carsales AU research page also lists 1,500kg braked (https://www.carsales.com.au/research/leapmotor/c10/2026/style/). No Leapmotor AU spec sheet found; Auto Express UK says the C10 'isn't rated to tow'. Kept, low confidence

warrantyYears.note: Leapmotor AU warranty page: vehicle 'up to 6 years or 150,000 km', battery 8 years/160,000km; carsales lists 6yr/150,000km for the C10. CarExpert's 2025 review predates the MY25 cut from 7 years

insuranceAnnual.note: anchored to byd-sealion-7-premium ($54,990, $1,650) and leapmotor-b10-design-lr ($40,888, $1,600); small premium over Sealion 7 for a new brand with a thin repair network, value unchanged from held

depreciationCurve.note: one curve for every Leapmotor row (owner convention): the brand curve already used by leapmotor-b10 and the held C10 Style/Design LR rows. availability.note: Leapmotor AU has no public configurator or price list (pricing page defers to a calculator not readable here); C10 model page lists the 81.9kWh/510km WLTP Design LR with current 1 Oct-31 Dec 2026 offer terms.
